**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enable the trig witness only when calls target sincos**

On Linux Debug or other non-optimizing builds, `src/macros.h` implements `SINCOS`/`SINCOSF` as separate `sin`+`cos` calls because this CMake configuration never defines `HAVE_SINCOS`; only optimized GCC happens to fuse them into the wrapped symbols. Defining `MC_PHASE_COUNT_TRIG` for every non-Apple Unix build therefore leaves `phase_calls` at zero and makes `CpuPatchPhaseWindow` fail immediately against its `wx+wy` expectation in a standard Debug/default build. Gate this witness on an actual sincos configuration or count the fallback calls as well.
